name: Resemble AI
tagline: Resemble AI is a voice cloning and speech synthesis platform that creates custom AI voices from a small sample of audio — as little as three minutes of clean recording. Its API delivers ultra-low-latency voice generation for real-time applications like conversational AI and interactive games. Brands, game studios, and voice AI developers use it to build voices that sound indistinguishable from their human counterparts.
